description: The line plot illustrates the time cost associated with paper retrieval, comparing scenarios with and without pre-computation of features. The x-axis is labeled "Paper Number" and is on a linear scale, ranging from 1 to 256. The y-axis is labeled "Time Cost (s)" and is on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 35 seconds. The plot features two lines: the blue line represents the time cost without pre-computation, which starts at approximately 0 seconds for the first paper and increases exponentially to about 35 seconds for the 256th paper. The orange line represents the time cost with pre-computation, which remains constant at approximately 5 seconds across all paper numbers. This demonstrates that feature pre-computation significantly improves efficiency, maintaining a constant time cost regardless of the number of papers.
